scope: GT E0A and E0B published tables, N=5,6
statement: Three numerical fragilities qualify published E0 values; no published finding, report sentence or hypothesis uses the affected values. (1) E0's dense LU solve loses accuracy on improbable states: relative error up to 2.9e-6 at probability ~1e-12 (HELD N5, exact rational referee); in HELD N6 non-gradient cells it returned negative values that were clipped to exactly zero for 13-136 states per cell, so one_sided_transitions (published 120-2,136 in five cells) is an artefact (true value 0), and attachment_fraction_by_free_edge_count at densities of stationary mass 1e-14 to 1e-35 is wrong by up to 0.56. (2) E0's L1-stopped iteration in the saturated FREE N6 cells left states of mass 1e-33 to 1e-17 unconverged (relative error up to 1e15), so triangles_given_edge_count at those densities is noise. (3) edge_count_modes (strict peaks with exactly equal neighbours) and the 1e-15 inclusion threshold of top_net_currents depend on rounding. Every other published channel reproduces to 1e-10 absolute or 1e-8 relative in all 84 cells.
